intent: Technical Brief: Dell G7 System State Baseline
detected_fault: Fan failure or malfunction, Power supply issues, Motherboard or hardware failures
suggested_solution: Check for BIOS updates on the Dell website.
Run a virus scan and malware removal tool to ensure the system is free from infections.
Inspect the fan and power supply for signs of wear or damage.
Consider running a stress test (e.g., Prime95, OCCT) to identify potential hardware issues.
